notes.title: February Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h2] HELLO HEROES, NEAR AND FAR [/h2]
We grow ever closer to [b]ChronoDojo's[/b] launch! Woo-hoo! Let's spotlight a way to all sit on the same virtual couch together and play [b]ChronoDojo[/b]: [b]Remote Play Together![/b]  

[h2]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER[/h2]

The only thing better than saving the world from eeeevil using your Chrono-Fu skills... is teaming up and playing hero with all of your friends!  But what if you can't all get together on the same couch to enjoy the cozy co-op fun?  Thanks to Steam's Remote Play Together feature, now you can! ([i]well, virtually at least...[/i])

Unfamiliar with RPT?  It's easy!  Simply launch the [b]ChronoDojo Demo[/b], Shift-Tab (or Alt-Tab) to your friends list, and invite anyone to play!  You'll then automatically stream your game session to them, and they'll stream their inputs to you!  Boom! You're playing together remotely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/383a5ccce53552dfe77219f607756a1ef9cd3684.jpg[/img]

Dev confession- we've been utilizing RPT to playtest and develop ChronoDojo from very very early on!  We love it and are excited for you to try it out.  Let us know how it goes!  

 
[h2]REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER FEST & LET'S PLAYS[/h2]

The timing couldn't be better to spotlight RPT, because ChronoDojo will be in [b]Steam's Remote Play Together Fest![/b] (Feb. 12-19)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/df489154eeecd30ceded92bf683b61a041a6713a.jpg[/img]

Keep your eyes peeled, we'll be broadcasting Remote Play Together Let's Plays w/ fun foks from [b]as far away as the UK[/b] and with friends of ours including [b]George Fan[/b] (the braaaains behind PvZ, Octogeddon, and the recently-released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202750/Hardhat_Wombat/]HardHat Wombat[/url])!

notes.title: January Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h2] WELCOME BACK, CHRONO-FRIENDS! [/h2]
We hope you all had the awesomest of holiday seasons!  To kick off the new year, let's spotlight a wacky way to play [b]ChronoDojo[/b]: [b]Mini-games![/b]

[h2]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: MINI-GAMES[/h2]
Do you need a quick break from saving the world from evil?  Are you feeling the urge to fight your own friends for fun?  It's time to take an intermission from your heroic mission with multiple mini-games!

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/ff0f35653448a876e72cdb725db3117922409b5a.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
Step into the [b]Eat No Eat[/b] carnival tent in the parking lot of the mall to face waves of edible "EATS" [i](yummy street & junk food)[/i] and inedible "NO EATS" [i](cute critters that look very similar to EATS, but bite back!)[/i].  Whoever chomps the most EATS wins!
[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/09dcc92c5176e3f9ad2312dea15e1a9bbdd6de74.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
Board the pirate's treasure ship to plunder their cargo!  Haul [b]huge treasures[/b] to your [b]hero-specific chest[/b] while deftly dodging cannonballs, pesky pirates, and your own 'friends' [i](who can pilfer your prizes right out of your hands!)[/i] Whoever hoards the most booty wins!
[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/b2ecafc15faba3774d2fabc67cbb781a2b8384d4.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
Venture into an active volcano to forage for delicious fungi!  Stay ahead of the [b]swiftly-rising magma[/b], avoid explosive [b]boom shrooms[/b] and [b]gather green 'shrooms[/b] as you race to the peak!  Whoever harvests the most mushrooms is the [i]champignon champion[/i]!
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Dang!  Doesn't that all sound mega-fun?  Let's play some Mini-games!
[previewyoutube=zIsothEIi0U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: December Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h2] HEY THERE, HUMBLE HEROES! [/h2]
Another marvelous month has passed as we polish, playtest and punch bugs in prep for launching [b]ChronoDojo[/b] next year!  As [i]this year[/i] nears an end, we'd love to spotlight some adorably fun features: 
[b]Pets & Egg Defense[/b]! 

[h2]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: PETS & EGG DEFENSE[/h2]
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/03c9f3abe24d0f20cc9d48bc248a4154bd572d3e.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
Meet a fellow hero and time-traveler- "[b]Tender, the Time-traveling Naturalist![/b]"  Her monumental mission is to locate and save super-special species the moment before they go extinct!
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/a95f4d08021128d52c0b75c23102da6abf79dd3c.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
She'll mark on your world maps [i](including previous worlds you've saved)[/i] with newly-located eggs.  You'll then need to bash, build and defend the Dojo all over again on those levels, but this time- you must also protect the fragile friendly egg from being fractured by the forces evil!  
[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/bc255f3903dc5f09e34bec18327e551d3572e650.png[/img]
[/td]  
[td]
If you can save both the enormous egg and the Dojo, Tender will reward you by hatching it into a loyal, powerful pet that will follow you into future battles and fight along your side!  Woo hoo!  Collect all the unique pets to see which perfectly pairs with your play style!
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
But let's let Tender take the mic, after all- she's the egg explorer extraordinaire!:
[previewyoutube=FXTZ8fCeNQg;full][/previewyoutube][i]Save the world, if only for the pets![/i]

notes.title: November Game Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]HELLO, STUDENTS OF CHRONO-FU![/h2]
Since our announcement a month ago at NextFest, we've been bashing, bug-swatting and beautifying ChronoDojo, and are on track for a release early next year!  Let's take a quick break to spotlight a crazy cool chrono-feature and to highlight and thank you for great changes based on your fine feedback!


[h2]FEATURE SPOTLIGHT: CHRONOPOWERS[/h2]
Soon after defeating Channel Omega and saving the 80's Sunset Plaza Mall, the ChronoDojo whisks our humble heroes away to the next world and time... and Sensei teaches them their unique [b]ChronoPowers[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/44ca758a2e26fcb61503ff9b00ce6c95526a4284.png[/img]
ChronoPowers are ultimate hero abilities that both spawn a powerful ChronoPower Tower (unique to each hero) and chrono-boosts your hero to turbo-bash baddies and move at manic speeds!  

But Sensei is a much better teacher.  Check out her lesson:
[previewyoutube=eyiOnZ9iPr4;full][/previewyoutube][b][i]Now that's playing with (Chrono) power![/i][/b]


[h2]DEMO FEEDBACK[/h2]
We are pumped up by how many times our demo has been downloaded and played and hope you're all having a heck-ton of fun!  Further- we are overjoyed to receive feedback, both negative and positive, to help us improve ChronoDojo!

[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339007/41ecb639eebb0ed59ff948680f20ca033927b1c5.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Helpful highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] Nerfing and smoothing of early World 1 difficulty ramp
[*] Re-balance of early-game Gardener weapons
[*] Re-balance of Channel Omega boss battle [i](early economy and difficulty)[/i]!
[*] Pinata no longer damages Dojo, nor does it drop candy if Dojo defeats it!
[/list]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]NEW BUILD![/h2]
Steam should update you to the latest build [i](v.010)[/i], where you can check out these changes and more.  Check it out, let us know what you think, and if you haven't yet, [b]wish list ChronoDojo today[/b]!
